kurz: Several people can sign in on the online site – each with their own password and two-factor. You add them, give them an activation code and assign a role and projects – at the PC or on the go on the online site. Until then a new user has no rights.
brauchst: The online site and online storage, set up (Settings › Online storage and Online site).
The Workbench at the PC or the online site: Settings › Users. Online you need the role project admin or system admin.
For each user a phone with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator …).

schritte.text: Settings › Users of the online site › enter a name › “Add”. The name is what they sign in with (no spaces).

Choose “Activate” for the user. The AMW shows an activation code (16 characters, e.g. `K7QM-2XRD-9WFH-T4PB`) – exactly once, valid for 24 hours. Give it to the user in person, spoken or in a chat. It is stored nowhere else.

The user opens the online site, chooses “First sign-in”, enters name and code, sets a password (at least 12 characters) and scans the QR code with their app. With the first number from the app their access is set up.
You get the message “New user … awaiting approval” (also as a push). Until then they only see “Your access is being reviewed”. Choose their role and projects and save.

werte: works in their projects: answer questions, messages, tasks, documents, approvals, pausing.

additionally the settings of their projects and agents – and the users of their projects: add, activate, role up to project admin, block. Users who are also in other projects or are project admins themselves are activated, blocked or given a new role only by a system admin. They do not see system admins or users without one of their projects.
everything, in all projects. At the PC you are always system admin, as with the existing access of the online site.
fehler: Typo, code expired or already used. Upper/lower case and dashes do not matter. Remedy: reset access.
The number from the app is not accepted
The phone's clock is off. Let the phone set the time automatically; the site accepts numbers up to 30 seconds off.
“Time is up” at the QR code
More than 10 minutes passed between code and QR code. Start again with the same activation code – it stays valid until the access is fully set up.
“Your access is being reviewed” does not go away
Role and projects are still missing. Assign them at the PC or online, then the user reloads the page.
As a project admin only what concerns your own projects works; blocking yourself or changing your own role is done by another admin.
danach: Forgotten password or lost phone: “Reset access”. Password and two-factor are reset, all of the user's sessions end, and they set both up again with the new code.
Blocking takes effect with their next request. Unblocking restores the previous access.
What a user writes online carries their name in the history.
fragen: The AMW does not send emails. The code is passed on in person; someone who only knows the name cannot get in without it.
Can someone else use the code?
Only if they have it and are faster. Then the right user sees “already used” and tells you – you block, reset access and pass on the new code.
I'm on the go – can I activate users on my phone?

Yes. The online site creates the code itself and shows it once; only its hash is stored. The PC then checks again whether you were allowed to – if not, it invalidates the code at once. Role and projects you change online are applied by the PC within seconds.
Where are password and two-factor stored?
Only in the online storage, as a hash or secret – never on the PC, never in the history. Of the activation code only a hash is stored there.
